parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom structural part of the storage cabinet, made of plywood for stability and support.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the entire cabinet structure and bears the load of stored items.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Right)
parts.Basic_description: The right cabinet door is a wooden panel attached to the frame with hinges.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the cabinet interior by swinging open and closed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinge axis to open or close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Left)
parts.Basic_description: The left cabinet door is a wooden panel similar to the right door, attached with hinges.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the left side of the cabinet interior.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinge axis to open or close.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame forms the main body and structural enclosure of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity and supports the doors, shelves, and base.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf (Lower)
parts.Basic_description: The lower shelf is a horizontal wooden panel inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a surface for storing items within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf (Upper)
parts.Basic_description: The upper shelf is a horizontal wooden panel positioned above the lower shelf.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional storage space for smaller or lighter items.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal use.
